arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import mistune
from mistune import create_markdown
from mistune.renderers.markdown import MarkdownRenderer
root = Path.cwd().resolve()
assert Path(mistune.__file__).resolve() == root / 'src/mistune/__init__.py'
render = create_markdown(renderer=MarkdownRenderer())
expected = "- list\n- \n"
actual = None
try:
    actual = render(expected)
except IndexError as error:
    tb, last = error.__traceback__, None
    while tb is not None:
        path = Path(tb.tb_frame.f_code.co_filename).resolve()
        if path.is_relative_to(root):
            last = (path.relative_to(root), tb.tb_frame.f_code.co_name, tb.tb_lineno)
        tb = tb.tb_next
    if last is None:
        raise
    print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
    print(f"{last[0]}:{last[2]} in {last[1]}")
else:
    print(repr(actual))
assert actual == expected
PYREPLAY
